segments.iti33:2.1: “Dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.iti33:2.3: Bhaddakena ca sīlena, bhaddikāya ca diṭṭhiyā.
segments.iti33:2.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge”ti.
segments.iti33:3.3: Etehi dvīhi dhammehi, yo samannāgato naro;
segments.iti33:3.5: Kāyassa bhedā sappañño, saggaṃ so upapajjatī”ti.
segments.iti33:4.1: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.

lines: Tañhi akhaṇḍādisīlabhāvena sayañca kalyāṇaṃ, samathavipassanādikalyāṇaguṇāvahaṃ cāti “bhaddakan”ti vuccati.
Bhaddikāya ca diṭṭhiyāti kammassakatāñāṇena ceva kammapathasammādiṭṭhiyā ca.
Tattha bhaddakena sīlena payogasampanno hoti, bhaddikāya diṭṭhiyā āsayasampanno.
“imehi, kho, bhikkhave, dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto, evaṃ sagge”ti.
